text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This is the very race that Mejiro Ramonu ran in,
the first-ever Triple Tiara winner...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Not just the Triple Tiara races,
Ramonu-san won even the prep races to achieve
a 'Flawless Triple Crown'—!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This place is... well, the start of a legend.
The place where the very first step was taken.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm standing on that very stage, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, fuuuuuh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Oh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You have a sterner look on your face than I expected, Craft.
I thought you'd be more excited,
like back during the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... Heart-san—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Are you feeling unwell?
Shall I give your back a good pat today?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'd be in trouble if my rival
weren't at the top of her game, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Nuh-uh, I'm okay.
I'm feeling great! Don't you worry."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: In that case, that's wonderful to hear.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Messiah-san...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Let us clash with all our might.
No holding back, and no excuses."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"A victory earned through a clash of true全力—
that must be what everyone desires, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You're right.
I feel that way too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly... I'm troubled.
Before I know it, my mind drifts back to it.
To what Trainer and I talked about at the start of the year.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(A path outside the Triple Tiara...
Talking about whether there might be
another possibility for me.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I thought about it, but...
In the end, I—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I won't lose. Messiah-san, Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to think I've come to know your strength, your resolve...
I'd like to think I understand. But still!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "I'll show you... that I'm just as strong as anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... I just have to prove it!
A strength that won't lose to the two of them, right here!
To Trainer, too...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(If I do that! Even Trainer...
will believe that I can still make it on the Triple Tiara path...!)
